clock_waveform.SDR_strobe_source: Host-generated WE_n / RE_n; asynchronous (no continuous clock).
clock_waveform.NV_DDR_clock_source: Host-generated CLK on the WE_n pin; rising-edge latches command/address.
clock_waveform.sdr_data_latching: Card outputs change on falling edge of RE_n; host samples on rising/falling per timing table.
clock_waveform.nv_ddr_data_latching: Both edges of DQS latch data; CLK rising edge latches command/address.
clock_waveform.nv_ddr2_3_data_latching: Both edges of DQS_t (cross with DQS_c) latch data; WE_n rising edge latches command/address.

command_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: Single command-cycle pulse: CE_n LOW, CLE HIGH, ALE LOW, WE_n LOW→HIGH (rising edge latches DQ[7:0] as command opcode); minimum WE_n pulse width = tWP.

address_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: 1..5 address-cycle pulses: CE_n LOW, CLE LOW, ALE HIGH, WE_n LOW→HIGH (rising edge latches DQ[7:0] as address byte).

write_data_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: N data-cycle pulses: CE_n LOW, CLE LOW, ALE LOW, WE_n LOW→HIGH (rising edge latches DQ[7:0] as write data byte). N depends on operation (page size + spare).

read_data_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: N data-cycle pulses: CE_n LOW, CLE LOW, ALE LOW, RE_n HIGH→LOW (falling edge causes device to drive next byte on DQ); host samples DQ after tREA.

cmd_addr_data_waveform_nv_ddr.description: Continuous CLK; CE_n LOW; CLE/ALE indicate cycle type; cmd/addr latched on rising CLK edge; tCAD interval between successive cycles. Data: W/R_n selects bus owner, DQS bidirectional source-synchronous.

cmd_addr_data_waveform_nv_ddr2_3.description: CE_n LOW; cmd/addr latched on WE_n rising edge during CLE/ALE HIGH; data on DQS_t edges. NV-DDR3 adds RE_t/RE_c differential RE for reads.

ready_busy_waveform.signal: R/B_n open-drain output; pulled HIGH externally; driven LOW by device when any LUN operation is in progress.
ready_busy_waveform.after_program: R/B_n LOW from end of 10h cycle to end of tPROG.
ready_busy_waveform.after_erase: R/B_n LOW from end of D0h cycle to end of tBERS.
ready_busy_waveform.after_read: R/B_n LOW from end of 30h cycle to end of tR (array→page-register).
ready_busy_waveform.after_reset: R/B_n LOW from end of FFh cycle to end of tRST.

reset_waveform.step_3: After tRST (max 5 ms during power-on, max 500 µs after first reset, max 5 µs for Synchronous Reset / Reset LUN), device drives R/B_n HIGH.
reset_waveform.step_4: Device defaults to SDR data interface, timing mode 0 (FFh); Synchronous Reset (FCh) keeps the active data interface and timing mode.

page_program_waveform.step_3: Host writes page-size bytes of data (CLE=ALE=0).
page_program_waveform.step_5: After tWB, device drives R/B_n LOW for tPROG.
page_program_waveform.step_6: Host polls Read Status (70h) or waits for R/B_n HIGH; checks FAIL bit.

block_erase_waveform.step_4: After tWB, device drives R/B_n LOW for tBERS.
block_erase_waveform.step_5: Host polls Read Status; checks FAIL bit.

read_waveform.step_2: Host issues 5 address cycles (2 column + 3 row).
read_waveform.step_4: After tWB, device drives R/B_n LOW for tR.
read_waveform.step_5: Device drives R/B_n HIGH; host issues Read Status Enhanced (78h) or Read Status (70h) to confirm.
read_waveform.step_6: Host pulses RE_n (SDR) or RE_t/RE_c with DQS (NV-DDR family) to clock out page-size bytes.

zq_calibration_waveform.step_1: Host issues ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) or Short (D9h).
zq_calibration_waveform.step_2: Device drives R/B_n LOW for tZQCL (long, ≥ 1 µs) or tZQCS (short).
zq_calibration_waveform.step_3: Device updates output driver impedance against external RZQ.
zq_calibration_waveform.step_4: Device drives R/B_n HIGH; output drivers now use updated impedance for subsequent NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 traffic.

general_timing_parameters_referenced: tDS / tDH — data setup / hold to WE_n rising
tWB — WE_n HIGH to R/B_n LOW
tWHR — WE_n HIGH to RE_n LOW (Read Status)
tZQCL / tZQCS — ZQ Calibration Long / Short
tDQSCK / tDQSRE / tDQSD / tDQSHZ / tDQSQ / tQH (NV-DDR family)
tWPRE / tWPST / tRPRE / tRPST — DQS write / read preamble / postamble
general_timing_rule: All command, address, and data transfers reference host strobes (WE_n / CLK for cmd/addr; RE_n / DQS for data). Setup/hold to WE_n rising for SDR cmd/addr/write-data; both edges of DQS for NV-DDR family data. Section 4.17 of ONFI 4.1 defines per-mode timing tables: SDR (Section 4.18.1), NV-DDR (4.18.2), NV-DDR2/3 (4.18.3).
